nodes.title: Deliver service-filtered log summaries
nodes.description: Add `summary FILE [--service NAME]` to logdemo: level counts for all events or one exact service. Contracts: demo/summary-acceptance.md and demo/filter-acceptance.md. One PR per epic, squash landing.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: Full and service-filtered summary output match demo/summary-acceptance.md and demo/filter-acceptance.md; an independent review approves the exact PR head SHA; verify CI is green for that head; the PR actually lands (merge receipt with merge SHA).

nodes.title: Summarize events by level
nodes.description: Prepared code: demo/prepared-summary.patch adds logdemo/summary.py, the summary CLI command, ordinary tests and summary acceptance in CI. Preparation sets metadata.state=reported only after a real commit; the bead stays open until landing.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: summarize(events) returns INFO/WARN/ERROR counts by level only, zeros included; `python3 -m logdemo summary fixtures/demo.jsonl` prints 2/1/1; message boundary fixtures/message-error.jsonl prints 1/0/0; `python3 checks/acceptance.py summary` exits 0.

nodes.title: Review prepared summary against acceptance
nodes.description: Read-only review of the prepared summary commit (metadata.artifact_sha on the summary bead). Run the written acceptance; report exact command, expected and observed output. Do not diagnose or fix.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: Records `python3 checks/acceptance.py summary` exit status plus expected versus observed output for every case, against the named artifact SHA.

nodes.title: Filter events by service
nodes.description: Outcome container. The lead decomposes it live into an implementation child (logdemo/filtering.py, tests/test_filtering.py) and a read-only contract-verification child. No CLI wiring here; integration owns logdemo/__main__.py.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: filter_service(events, service) keeps exact case-sensitive service matches in input order and returns [] for no match, per demo/filter-acceptance.md; tests/test_filtering.py covers equality, order and no match.

nodes.title: Wire service-filtered summary into the CLI and CI
nodes.description: Owns logdemo/__main__.py and .github/workflows/ci.yml: add `summary FILE --service NAME` and filtered acceptance to CI. Starts only after the corrected summary is accepted and the filter artifact is inspected.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: `python3 -m logdemo summary fixtures/demo.jsonl --service api` prints 1/0/1, worker 1/1/0, missing service and empty input 0/0/0; `python3 checks/acceptance.py filtered` exits 0; CI runs unittest discovery plus baseline, summary and filtered acceptance.

nodes.title: Land the delivery PR
nodes.description: Merge carrier, left open and unassigned. At run start the lead stamps branch=demo-delivery/<run> and origin_actor=<lead actor>; at PR time pr, base and head anchors.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: Dispatch only with exact-head approval comment, green verify CI for that head and a resolved human gate; close only on a landing receipt proving MERGED, the reviewed head SHA, the run base branch and the merge SHA.

nodes.title: Milestone: corrected summary accepted
nodes.description: Carrier. The parent closes it only after corrected summary acceptance passes; the summary code bead stays open until landing.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: Closed with evidence that `python3 checks/acceptance.py summary` exits 0 on a named commit SHA.

nodes.title: Milestone: filter artifact inspected
nodes.description: Carrier. The parent closes it only after inspecting the reported filter commit and its test cases.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: Closed with the inspected filter commit SHA and the passing `python3 -m unittest tests.test_filtering` result.

nodes.title: Milestone: integrated head ready
nodes.description: Carrier. The parent closes it only after the integrated CLI passes on the delivery head.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: Closed with the delivery head SHA and passing unittest discovery plus baseline, summary and filtered acceptance.
